853:t_88:12.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Since we've got the chance, don't you want to hear what's happened since then?」

853:t_88:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you'd have me, please tell me.」

853:t_88:14.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Then it'll be a long story, but...」

853:t_88:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Miss $$アスカ$$... I pray that peace may come to you at last...)

853:t_89:6.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「When you said congratulations, I felt warm...」

853:t_89:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is how people make each other feel warm.」

853:t_89:8.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Can I... make someone feel warm too?」

853:t_89:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you can. Just talking with Miss $$レイ#pt394$$ like this already makes me feel warm.」

853:t_89:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This is how Miss $$レイ#pt394$$ grows, too... I look forward very much to seeing how she changes from here on.)

853:t_90:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$アヤナミレイ$$!」

853:t_90:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not much of a reaction, I see...」

853:t_90:6.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「In a moment like this... what would $$綾波レイ$$ do?」

853:t_90:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thinking that through for yourself may be your task from here on, Miss $$アヤナミレイ$$.」

853:t_90:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You could even call it the meaning of living.」

853:t_90:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I wonder where this person will end up, too... Will the destination be hope, or despair...)

853:t_91:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, well... I never thought a chance like this would come along.」

853:t_91:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, I'll keep plugging along at my own pace from here on, so I'm counting on you.」

853:t_91:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(In the end, her existence remained a mystery...)

853:t_92:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「AG... How much do you actually know?」

853:t_92:6.en:
$$マリ$$
「What happened after that... And about our world.」

853:t_92:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... even a dimensional merchant's information network has its limits...」

853:t_92:8.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... if you want to play dumb, fine. We're even on that score.」

853:t_92:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「For now, I don't mind this lukewarm relationship of ours. Until things get hopeless, I plan to keep it just as it is, nya.」

853:t_92:11.en:
$$マリ$$
「If I can confirm that, OK. Let's get along for now, nya.」

853:t_92:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(When it comes to this person, it truly is a mystery... The information I picked up at a certain place might even be from a parallel world...)

853:t_93:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It isn't exactly a bonus prize, but I've prepared a light meal.」

853:t_93:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now... No one is watching, so please take off your mask and dig in.」

853:t_93:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see... So that's what you're after. But...!」

853:t_93:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've already cleared that condition! I have completely mastered the art of eating with my mask on.」

853:t_93:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then how about this piping hot oden...」

853:t_93:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「S-something like this... Hot! Could never shake my... hot, hot... my vow... Hot!!」

853:t_93:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... really love that about you, Mr. $$ゼロ$$.」

853:t_94:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your expression has softened quite a bit.」

853:t_94:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「This unit is comfortable to be in.」

853:t_94:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, stop. Let's not have that kind of talk today.」

853:t_94:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, Mr. $$スザク$$ has contributed to peace by taking down 80 enemy units, at the very least.」

853:t_94:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「...You're right. I'll keep doing my best.」

853:t_94:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even a long, steep road comes to an end someday. Please don't give up, Mr. $$スザク$$.」

853:t_95:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「You don't have a bunny suit, do you?」

853:t_95:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're on your guard from the start!」

853:t_95:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Put your hand on your chest and think back on everything you've done.」

853:t_95:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Who said to put a hand on MY chest!? I meant your own, obviously!」

853:t_95:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-but... my chest... isn't any fun to touch...」

853:t_95:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't go turning other people's chests into something fun on your own!!」

853:t_96:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You've got the pizza ready, haven't you?」

853:t_96:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course. I've also prepared the toppings of Miss $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$'s choice.」

853:t_96:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In front of Miss $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, I'm as gooey as the cheese on a pizza.」

853:t_96:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So please give me more of that cold smile... more, more!」

853:t_96:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You don't seem to be hiding your own tastes anymore...」

853:t_97:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「This is nothing for me, man.」

853:t_97:5.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Hold on, $$アポロ$$. Don't think you won this ace title by your strength alone.」

853:t_97:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That's right! Don't forget it's thanks to Brother and me sticking to the unsung work behind the scenes!」

853:t_97:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If it bugs you that much, split up the Vectors and become Mars and Luna!」

853:t_97:8.en:
$$シリウス$$
「You...! Saying the one thing you must never say!」

853:t_97:9.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I won't forgive you, $$アポロ$$!」

853:t_97:10.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Uh-oh! Looks like I got them serious!」

853:t_97:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Funny how that works... Yet once they're in battle, their teamwork is flawless.)

853:t_97:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... I'll send them 12,000 years' worth of congratulations.)
